text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P-4892 triggered — eu-west GPU pool at 94% alloc, autoscaler attempted provisioning but failed to spin new nodes. Paging @marie (oncall). Alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/p/4892

marie (oncall): On it. I'm looking at the autoscaler logs now. @kevin can you confirm whether quota exhaustion or preemptions are the root cause?

kevin (sre): Looking. GCE reports GPU quota consumed and preemptible pool churned ~30% in the last 10m. There's a large batch job from `batch-eta` that started ~03:12 UTC and consumed most spare capacity.

helen (product-ops): That batch run was supposed to be dev-only but it used shared pool qualifiers somehow. I'm pulling the job metadata.

marie (oncall): For immediate mitigation: disabling autoscale surge on eu-west pool and enabling routing override to prefer us-central fallback. Applied routing override: `region_preference: [eu-west2, us-central1], fallback:true` — will monitor.

ajay: Can we confirm customer impact? CE reported elevated 500s for embeddings in EU — roughly 1.8%-2.5% error spike over 15m. Any high-value customers impacted?

ce-support: Noted one large media customer saw retries and slower responses, they opened a support ticket. They accepted fallback but requested a post-incident comms.

tom (eng-runtime): Pushed temporary autoscaler config change to reduce min-replica-safety from 0.6 -> 0.4 for the eu-west pool to accept smaller headroom while we stabilize. Monitoring metrics now.

marie (oncall): After routing override and config change, 95th p99 latencies dropped back to baseline within ~4m. Latency graphs: https://metrics.redwood.example/d/xyz. Good immediate recovery. Still need follow-ups to prevent recurrence.

kevin (sre): Immediate action items I propose:
- Reserve 2 spare GPU nodes in eu-west for peak windows (capacity reserve)
- Quarantine `batch-eta` to an isolated compute pool with resource tags
- Add quota alerting at 85% with early paging so autoscaler has time to react

ajay: Scheduling a post-incident sync (post-incident review): Thursday 2025-03-20 10:00 UTC. Agenda: root cause, runbook updates, customer comms. Owners: kevin (capacity), tom (autoscaler), helen (process).

product-ops: Also add an action to evaluate short-term burst contracts with cloud provider for emergency capacity (24–48h uplift).

marie (oncall): Assigning tasks now — please create Jira tickets and comment here with links. I'll open the incident doc and invite CE for comms. TODOs: verify quota alert thresholds, runbook section for "shared-pool isolation", and confirm billing/accounting for reserved GPUs.

incident-bot: Incident P-4892 marked RESOLVED by marie (oncall). Duration: 24m. Post-incident sync scheduled: 2025-03-20T10:00:00Z — https://meet.redwood.example/PI-P4892

kevin (sre): I opened a PR for the runbook: `docs/runbooks/autoscaler-capacity-checklist.md` — pending review. Jira: INFRA-1742 (Reserve GPUs), INFRA-1743 (Isolate batch jobs), INFRA-1744 (Quota alerts).

ajay: Nice work. Please keep this thread updated as Jira tasks progress. Closing pager for now. :thumbsup:

marie (oncall): Thanks team — I'll follow up with a short public incident note for customers and link the postmortem after the sync.

---
Temporary routing snippet used during mitigation:
```yaml
routing_override:
  prefer_regions: [\"eu-west2\", \"us-central1\"]
  fallback: true
  max_shift_percent: 30
```

Action items summary (short):
- INFRA-1742: Reserve 2x GPUs in eu-west (kevin)
- INFRA-1743: Create isolated pool + migrate batch-eta (kevin/helen)
- INFRA-1744: Add quota early-warning alert at 85% (tom/kevin)
- RUNBOOK-PR: autoscaler-capacity-checklist.md (kevin)
- CUSTOMER-COMMS: post-incident note + CE outreach (marie/helen)

Please update Jira numbers in this thread as they change.
